name: Eight-Vertex Ample Daisy Obstruction
definition: Take $P=\{p\}$, $R=\{a,b,e\}$, $A=\{a\}$, and the five-state down-set $\mathcal W_8=\langle\{a\},\{b,e\}\rangle$. Delete $(P,A)$ and $(\varnothing,R\setminus A)$ from $2^P\times\mathcal W_8$.
properties: The resulting graph has eight vertices, isometric dimension four, and is an ample pc-minimal obstruction to being a daisy cube. Its ten-vertex daisy host has a five-vertex single-root factor, so it is not one of the punctured $P_3^r\square Q_s$ product-host obstructions of the same order.
